{
  "name": "request",

    "http",
    "simple",
    "util",
    "utility"
  ],
  "version": "2.88.1",
  "author": "Mikeal Rogers <mikeal.rogers@gmail.com>",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "https://github.com/request/request.git"
  },
  "bugs": {
    "url": "http://github.com/request/request/issues"
  },
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">= 6"
  },
  "main": "index.js",
  "files": [
    "lib/",
    "index.js",
    "request.js"
  ],
  "dependencies": {
    "aws-sign2": "~0.7.0",
    "aws4": "^1.8.0",

    "performance-now": "^2.1.0",
    "qs": "~6.5.2",
    "safe-buffer": "^5.1.2",
    "tough-cookie": "~2.5.0",
    "tunnel-agent": "^0.6.0",
    "uuid": "^3.3.2"

  "scripts": {

    "test-browser": "node tests/browser/start.js",

  "devDependencies": {
    "bluebird": "^3.2.1",

    "karma-phantomjs-launcher": "^1.0.0",
    "karma-tap": "^3.0.1",
    "nyc": "^14.1.1",
    "phantomjs-prebuilt": "^2.1.3",
    "rimraf": "^2.2.8",
    "server-destroy": "^1.0.1",
    "standard": "^9.0.0",
    "tape": "^4.6.0",
    "taper": "^0.5.0"
  },
  "greenkeeper": {
    "ignore": [
      "hawk",
      "har-validator"
    ]
